findings.statement: Packet-composition information helps throughput-only prediction, but the compact workload equation loses to the flexible comparator.

findings.limitations: Compact wins only 1/5 runs against flexible; routerA standalone byte-load coefficient is negative. Packet rate is algebraic throughput/size rather than independent energy evidence.
falsification: Compare whole-run errors by router/protocol and retain the missing power response.
Keep algebraic packet-rate derivation explicit and test matched information access.
Require a future-input perturbation test for any dynamic submission and independently timed temperature for thermal claims.
